name: Architectural editorial frames
art: Inspect the image list and exact arch layout in the cited source. Curate original or licensed assets with comparable visual weight and complementary crops.

properties.label: Monumental heading over image frieze
properties.text: Place a monumental single-word serif heading above a seven-strip frieze, balancing it with a short editorial note and small Change the view action on the quieter side.

properties.label: Cultivated spacious editorial type
properties.text: Use cultivated spacious serif display type with calm supporting copy rather than dashboard typography.

properties.label: Warm ground with bounded imagery
properties.text: Use a warm light ground and dark ink, letting rich bounded imagery provide the chroma and depth.

properties.label: Varied architectural arch strips
properties.text: Build seven tall narrow strips with coherent proportions and a deliberate rhythm of full arches, one-shoulder curves and square tops.

properties.label: Curated material crop sequence
properties.text: Fill the frieze with intentional crops of folded paper, organic green texture and warm material, preserving distinct focal subjects and complementary visual weight.

properties.label: Stable Change the view selection
properties.text: Change the active view and its description together while retaining a stable reading anchor across input methods and narrow-screen reflow.

properties.label: Arch rhythm acceptance
properties.text: Compare strip spacing, shoulder curves, baseline and image contrast; every arch needs a meaningful focal subject rather than a random stock crop.
